$comment: Founder curation for the demo seed (scripts/seed-demo-account.ts). Keys under `runs` are ORIGINAL run ids from your own account; `notes`/`driverNotes` replace the scrubbed text wholesale. `includeThreadIds` lists YOUR EngineerChatThread ids to copy as the demo's curated history. `nameScrub` adds mates' names → replacements. Edit and re-run demo:seed — it wipes and reseeds idempotently.
$includeThreadIdsComment: Populated 2026-08-06. This array sat EMPTY, which is the entire reason the public demo's Engineer rendered 'No past conversations yet' — the seed's copy loop is correct, it simply had nothing to iterate. Ids must be YOUR OWN threads under SOURCE_USER_ID; the seed skips any it cannot find under that user, with a warning, so a deleted thread degrades quietly instead of failing the seed.
$excludedThreadComment: DELIBERATELY NOT LISTED: cmrwzy4cs0003jl04s86zyd3w, the beginner 'why is it so hard to turn my car' question. It reads well and scripts/dev-copy-demo-engineer-threads.ts copies it, but it belongs to nicshanaya23@gmail.com — a real user, not the founder — and the demo is a PUBLIC page. The seed's userId filter already refuses it; this note exists so nobody 'fixes' that filter to make it work. If you want a beginner question in the demo, ask one from your own account and list that id here.
$expandedComment: EXPANDED 2026-08-25 from 2 threads to 16. The demo no longer answers live questions (founder call — /api/engineer/chat came off the demo write allowlist), so this list IS the Engineer in the demo. Two threads was not a history, it was a sample. Chosen for spread rather than volume: what the Engineer read off an actual run, a long back-and-forth where the first change made the car worse, planning a test day from previous ones, and the plain-language questions a driver actually types. Duplicates of the same question were dropped — the founder asked several of these three or four times while testing.
$readBeforeShippingComment: ELEVEN OF THESE PREDATE THE v0 ENGINEER REBUILD (2026-08-05), which deliberately runs on less context than the system that answered them (see CLAUDE.md and ENGINEER_NORTH_STAR.md). They are the meatiest answers in the account, which is exactly why they are a risk: a demo that shows answers the shipping Engineer would not produce today oversells, and an oversold demo becomes a refund. Marked `pre-v0` in $threadNotes below. Read those eleven before a public launch and cut any that no longer represent what the app does. cmqm1kpu00001l20451u22ajw ('where is my setup compared to the average') was cut on exactly this test — it leans on community context v0 may no longer carry.
